'ramellia' is filed in Turkey (classes 14, 25, 35), which is outside the offices checked.
pending_verify.conflict_note: No software, tech, AI or agency brand uses the name. The name is closely linked to Serge Ramelli, a well-known French-American photographer and Lightroom/Photoshop educator who sells presets and courses under his full name. Others are Ramelli Janitorial Service Inc (Louisiana) and scattered people with the surname. ramelli.com is taken.
pending_verify.language_note: Italian surname with no meaning in English, Spanish, French, Italian or Hungarian. In Serbian 'rame' means shoulder, which is neutral. In German there is a faint echo of the vulgar colloquial 'rammeln', but the stress differs (ra-MEL-li vs RAM-meln), so the risk is low. It reads Italian rather than Latin or hard-consonant, so it is softer than the Braze/Brame anchors.
pending_verify.story: Agostino Ramelli (1531-c.1610) was an Italian engineer. His 1588 book of machines introduced the 'book wheel', a rotating reading desk often called the first hypertext machine, which suits catalogue software like Quicktalog. TMview shows nothing in software classes, and every domain except .com is free.

pending_verify.name: Bodmer
pending_verify.tm_note: TMview shows 21 hits and no live identical mark in class 9, 35 or 42 at USPTO, EUIPO, WIPO or Serbia. Identical BODMER marks exist only in Korea (classes 11 and 35, filed) and Mexico (36). Watch-outs: in Switzerland (IGE, outside the offices checked), Fondation Martin Bodmer holds 'BODMER LAB' in classes 9/16/35/37/41/42, and Rahn+Bodmer Co. (private bank) holds marks in 35/36/42. This matters if the company later wants to be 'Bodmer Labs'.
pending_verify.conflict_note: No established software, tech or agency company uses the name. The closest same-name uses are 'Bodmer Studio', a small Instagram account with about 230 followers, and Simone Bodmer-Turner Studio (a New York sculptor and designer). Nick Bodmer is an indie iOS developer who publishes apps under his own name. Outside tech, the name belongs to Rahn+Bodmer (a Zurich private bank since 1750), the Fondation Martin Bodmer / Bibliotheca Bodmeriana and the painter Karl Bodmer. bodmer.com, .io and .co are all taken.
pending_verify.language_note: Swiss-German surname with no negative meaning. In English 'bod' is harmless slang for body. The archaic German 'Bodmerei' (bottomry loan) is neutral. In Serbian 'bod' means point or stitch, which is neutral. Spanish 'boda' (wedding) is not close enough to matter. Nothing in French, Italian or Hungarian. It is short and hard (B-d-m), close to the Br-/-ct sound profile.
pending_verify.story: Johann Georg Bodmer (1786-1864) was a Swiss inventor-engineer in Manchester. He patented improvements to machine tools, gear cutting and textile machines, a quiet and precise maker. TMview shows only compound marks: a Swiss bank and the Bodmer Library foundation.
